Twitter does have a mute feature, but it's only used so that you don't see people's tweets in your timeline. What I'm thinking is just a service that would let you mute mentions and DM's for a specified amount of time, (anywhere from an hour to say, a week,) but no more than say 2 weeks, because after that, you should definitely use the block feature! As for building the service I have no web development expertise, so I'm not sure how you'd do it. I'm pretty sure that you'd have to make it a manual list that people update though. It would definitely have to be a separate web/mobile app, (I prefer webservices.)
